title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Demon Slayer Studio’s Next Big Movie – Watch Trailer
content: It’s been over a year since Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle released its first installment, but the animation studio has yet to confirm any updates on the upcoming movies. The Infinity Castle Arc will be adapted in a trilogy movie series, but fans still await a release window or even the first look at the second part.

title: Level 5's Holy Horror Mansion Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Release for Switch 2, PS5, PC
content: Level 5 unveiled during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream on Thursday its new "ghost craft" role-playing game HOLY HORROR MANSION , and it announces that the game will launch in 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Release Schedule Ahead of October Debut – Watch New Trailer
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender is coming back this Fall with the next major step of the story, and Avatar: Seven Havens has confirmed its episode release schedule ahead of its Paramount+ premiere with a new trailer showing it all off.

title: Death Note Stage Musical Will Return To London's Barbican Centre in 2027
content: The musical's current six-week run at the Barbican will end on this coming Saturday, September 12. As of writing, there are a few tickets left on Thursday. The musical also has a page at the Barbican website, where the tickets are also linked.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Will Be Released in UK IMAX Cinemas From November 3
content: Anime Limited has released a new trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki . The trailer confirms that the film will open in IMAX cinemas on November 3, and in general cinemas on November 6.
author: ANN

title: Compile Heart's Villion:Code Game Heads West in 2027
content: Idea Factory International announced on Thursday that it will release Villion:Code , developer Compile Heart 's new school RPG , in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Straight Edge Launches Horizontal Manga Label
content: Author agency and IP production company Straight Edge launched on Wednesday its own manga label called Straight Edge Comic (SEC), which will plan, edit, and publish manga in horizontal format. Additionally, STUDIO ZOON former editor-in-chief Kento Kaji will join Straight Edge as a manga editing adviser.
author: ANN

title: Major HIDIVE Isekai Reveals New Look at Season 2 Return After 4 Years
content: Ahead of its long-awaited return to the seasonal anime circuit, Reincarnated as a Sword just dropped a brand-new key visual of the series’ protagonists Fran and Teacher with a stunning updated design and a small sneak peek at what fans can expect when the anime begins airing in October 2026.
